newsitem.title: UK: UK Unionist says no change in party voting - Sky.
newsitem.headline: UK Unionist says no change in party voting - Sky.

text.p: Ulster Unionist leader David Trimble said on Thursday there was no change in his party's position and it would continue to vote on each issue according to its merits, Sky Television reported.
Trimble was talking after Conservative MP Iain Mills died putting the ruling party into a minority in parliament.
The Ulster Unionists have nine members of parliament (MPs) in the 651-seat House of Commons and their support has been vital to Prime Minister John Major's survival at key votes.
The Conservatives now have 322 MPs and the combined opposition have 323.
